integrity: The coordinate balances, polynomial derivative-energy certificate, and scalar jerk identity were replayed from the packaged exact-arithmetic checker. Literature comparisons are limited to material actually inspected.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures and periodic orbits, not unbounded trajectories.
For positive parameters it gives necessary structural laws but does not assert existence of nontrivial compact recurrence at every parameter pair.
The strict period lower bound is not claimed to be approached.
The complete 2004 analytical Sprott-flow article was not inspected and remains a bibliographic risk.
Targeted searches cannot exclude differently phrased or unindexed older statements.
title: Exact compact-recurrence phase diagram and strict period floor in the generalized Sprott S flow
